name: voice-reader
description: Hear Claude's replies: offline Kokoro voice, a summary or the full reply, per-section playback, pause and replay, all from a bar above the prompt

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Kokoro voice id. The first letter sets the language: a = US English (af_heart, am_michael), b = UK English (bf_emma, bm_george), e = Spanish (ef_dora), f = French (ff_siwis), h = Hindi (hf_alpha), i = Italian (if_sara), p = Portuguese (pf_dora), j = Japanese, z = Chinese

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Speaking speed, up to 2x for audiobook-style listening

model.title: Model
model.description: full (325 MB, best quality) or int8 (92 MB, faster to download)

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Model that writes the spoken summary (uses your Claude plan). none = read the opening sentences instead

announce.title: Spoken alerts
announce.description: Say when a session needs you, naming the project: permission prompts and questions, also after Claude has been idle, or never
